## Fixed

- **"Janitor refused this request for your account"** popped up for many of you. It wasn't Butler's fault: Janitor cracked down on automation, and it hit people on non-web clients, Janitor's own app included. Butler gets through again, and will keep adjusting if Janitor changes things. Thanks to arian_12, KarlozzTwT, TruckMiserable9538, Brilliant_Tourist_76, NovelThen1558 and kalayaannnn for reporting it.
- **Your generation settings travel again.** Since the 0.2.3 patch, proxy messages went out without your temperature, context size and the rest. If replies felt off lately, that was why.
- **The keyboard that kept coming back** on the home search after you closed it. (AromaticGarbage2174)
- **Choices now work on JLLM**, not only with a proxy. (Key_Coffee_4684)
- `{{user}}` in the history is filled in with your name, as the website does.
- When Cloudflare is the problem, Butler says so instead of blaming your account.

## New

- **Creator profiles.** Tap *by @creator* on any character: their characters, their lorebooks, Follow, and their bio the way they styled it, colours and CSS included. (Several_Watch3290)
- **Description writer**, a Butler special. Write a few lines about your persona, tap ✦ Enhance, pick one of your proxy presets, and it fleshes them out in your style, keeping everything you wrote. Undo if yours was better. (Black-Furred)
- **Favorites and Following** are chips on the home screen. (Alastor_Dub)
- **Tags** have a row of their own under Popular and Trending, in colour, with search by creators' own tags (#kinktober and the like) and the popular ones suggested.
- **JLLM custom prompt.** Pick any of your saved prompts for JLLM, like on the website. (Key_Coffee_4684)
- **Highlights prompt is editable**, so you can steer what your model picks out. (DonkeyDry6864, Annual-Collection432)
- **NSFW on mobile** switch in Settings › Model. If Write for me said "not allowed" on JLLM, turn it on. (Key_Coffee_4684)
- **Update check, optional.** Tap it in Settings › Updates, or let Butler check when it opens. It only asks GitHub for the newest version and links you to it; nothing downloads or installs by itself.
- Less fine print across Settings.

## Install

Grab **Butler-0.3.0.apk** below. It installs over any earlier version and keeps your chats and settings.
